name: Article 4 – § 1 – after point 1; Article 2 – paragraph 1 – point a – 79
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: Amendment (1 a) Article 2 is amended as follows: (a) in paragraph 1, point (a) is replaced by the following: ‘(a) the company had more than 5 000 employees on average and had a net worldwide turnover of more than EUR 1.5 billion in the last financial year for which annual financial statements have been or should have been adopted ;’;
